headerDisplay: Exposes each Bambu Lab printer's print status as a HomeKit Occupancy Sensor (occupied while actively printing) for use in automations.

name.title: Printer Name
name.description: Shown in Home app and every notification.

serialNumber.title: Serial Number
serialNumber.description: Found on the printer or in Bambu Studio.

mqttPort.title: MQTT Port
mqttPort.description: Leave as 8883 unless you know otherwise.

rejectUnauthorized.title: Verify TLS Certificate
rejectUnauthorized.description: Leave off — the printer's certificate is self-signed.

refreshIntervalSeconds.title: Full State Refresh Interval (s)
refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Extra safety-net poll on top of normal updates. 0 disables it — recommended.

reconnectDelaySeconds.title: Reconnect Base Delay (s)
reconnectDelaySeconds.description: Starting delay before the first retry after a dropped connection.

reconnectMaxDelaySeconds.title: Reconnect Max Delay (s)
reconnectMaxDelaySeconds.description: Retry delay is capped here during a long outage.

enableNetworkPresenceCheck.title: Ping Before Reconnecting
enableNetworkPresenceCheck.description: Skips a reconnect attempt entirely if the printer isn’t even on the network.

presenceCheckIntervalSeconds.title: Presence Check Interval (s)
presenceCheckIntervalSeconds.description: How often to ping when the above is enabled.

mqttReconnectAlertThreshold.title: Connection-Lost Alert Threshold
mqttReconnectAlertThreshold.description: Sends a push after this many failed reconnect attempts in a row.

useLiveActivity.title: Use a Live Activity
useLiveActivity.description: One persistent Lock Screen tile instead of separate push notifications.

liveActivityDevices.title: Live Activity Devices

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: From the Notify! app's Devices tab on that device, not the Group ID used elsewhere in this config.

liveActivityDevices.description: One row per phone you want the tile to appear on.

liveActivitySymbol.title: Icon (SF Symbol name)
liveActivitySymbol.description: Shown on the tile while printing.

liveActivityTint.title: Accent Color
liveActivityTint.description: Colors the progress bar, icon, and countdown text together.

liveActivityKeepForSeconds.title: Finished Tile Lingers For (s)
liveActivityKeepForSeconds.description: How long the completed tile stays up before clearing.

liveActivityUpdateIntervalPercent.title: Update Interval (%)
liveActivityUpdateIntervalPercent.description: How often the tile refreshes. Lightweight, so 1% is fine.

enableRequestTopicSniffing.title: ⚠️ AMS ID Sniffer (Diagnostic)
enableRequestTopicSniffing.description: OFF BY DEFAULT. Subscribes to the printer’s /request MQTT topic to watch commands sent by OTHER clients (Bambu Studio, Handy, the touchscreen) — used purely to discover values like the AMS drying ID by watching Studio’s own "Dry" button. This is a non-standard use of the MQTT connection beyond this plugin’s normal traffic. Turn on only while actively hunting for a value, then turn back off — leaving it on permanently adds unnecessary ongoing message traffic for no benefit once you’ve found what you needed.

activeStates.title: "Occupied" gcode States
activeStates.description: Which printer states count as actively printing.

filamentRunoutErrorCodes.title: Filament Run-Out Error Codes
filamentRunoutErrorCodes.description: print_error codes treated as a genuine run-out. Defaults cover known cases.

pingieGroupId.title: Pingie Group ID
pingieGroupId.description: From the Notify! app’s Group settings.

pingieGroupToken.title: Pingie Group Token
pingieGroupToken.description: From the Notify! app’s Group settings.

pingieIconUrl.title: Notification Icon URL
pingieIconUrl.description: Small icon shown on every push. Optional.

pingieImageUrl.title: Notification Image URL
pingieImageUrl.description: Larger image shown when a push is expanded. Optional.

averagePrintWattage.title: Average Print Power Draw (W)
averagePrintWattage.description: Used to estimate electricity cost. Leave blank to skip cost estimates.

progressNotificationIntervalPercent.title: Progress Push Interval (%)
progressNotificationIntervalPercent.description: How often a "Print progress" push fires. Set 0 to disable.

startNotificationDelaySeconds.title: Start Push Delay (seconds)
startNotificationDelaySeconds.description: Waits this long so the time estimate is ready first.

filamentPrices.title: Filament Prices

material.title: Material
material.description: Must match the type string exactly as it appears in your sliced files (e.g. PLA, PETG, ABS, PLA-CF) - case-sensitive.

filamentPrices.description: One row per material — add a Material and its Price per kg.

progressDisplayMode.title: Progress Display
progressDisplayMode.description: Which progress-style accessory(ies) to show in Home app.

lightAccessoryType.title: Chamber Light Accessory Type
lightAccessoryType.description: Use "switch" so Siri’s "turn off all the lights" doesn’t catch it mid-print.

enableAirPurifierSensor.title: Air Purifier Trigger Sensor
enableAirPurifierSensor.description: A Contact Sensor that opens after a print finishes, for automating a real air purifier.

airPurifierActiveDurationMinutes.title: Active Duration (minutes)
airPurifierActiveDurationMinutes.description: How long the sensor stays open after a print finishes.

liveActivityPurifierSymbol.title: Live Activity Icon (Purifying)
liveActivityPurifierSymbol.description: Shown on the tile during the purifying phase.

liveActivityTimezone.title: ETA Time Zone
liveActivityTimezone.description: IANA name, e.g. Europe/London. Keeps the ETA correct through BST/DST.

enableAiSpaghettiAssessment.title: AI Spaghetti Assessment
enableAiSpaghettiAssessment.description: Sends the snapshot to Anthropic for a text opinion. Advisory only — never acts on the printer.

enableAiAutoPauseOnSpaghetti.title: ⚠️ AI Autonomous Pause/Resume
enableAiAutoPauseOnSpaghetti.description: OFF BY DEFAULT. This only controls whether the "AI Auto-Pause" HomeKit switch exists - the switch itself is the real gate, and it resets to off automatically at the start of every new print, so it has to be manually turned on again each time you actually want it active. When on, an AI model’s judgment from a single photo can autonomously PAUSE or RESUME the print - more autonomous authority than Bambu’s own first-party AI monitoring exercises (their system only ever flags, it never acts). AI vision judgment from one photo is fallible in both directions: wrongly pausing interrupts a fine print, wrongly resuming lets a genuine failure keep running unsupervised. Only ever pauses/resumes, never a full cancel/abort, and fails toward doing nothing if the API call fails or the response can’t be parsed. Requires anthropicApiKey above.

amsId.title: AMS 2 Pro Drying ID
amsId.description: OFF BY DEFAULT — marked experimental because real, unresolved protocol unknowns remain, not just as a formality. Controls a physical heater inside the AMS 2 Pro automatically based on a humidity threshold. Two genuine open questions: the drying command’s AMS ID doesn’t follow the printer’s normal 0-3 numbering (found by community reverse-engineering, not officially documented), and the humidity scale itself isn’t confirmed to be a true percentage — even an actively-maintained community integration has an open, unanswered question about this. Defaults to Off between Homebridge restarts deliberately, since this is a heater. Test cautiously with an empty AMS before trusting it unattended.

amsHumidityUnitIndex.title: AMS Humidity Unit Index
amsHumidityUnitIndex.description: Which AMS unit (array position, not amsId) to read humidity from. 0 = first/only unit.

amsDryStartThreshold.title: AMS Dry Start Threshold
amsDryStartThreshold.description: Scale not confirmed - check the Homebridge log after enabling for a hint about whether this is a real percentage or a coarse 1-5 index.

amsDryTargetTemp.title: AMS Dry Target Temp (°C)
amsDryTargetTemp.description: Clamped to a minimum of 45 - the reverse-engineered command reportedly no-ops below that.

amsDryDurationHours.title: AMS Dry Hardware Failsafe Duration (hours)
amsDryDurationHours.description: Hardware-level cutoff independent of this plugin's own stop command, in case that never arrives (e.g. connection drop).

includeCameraSnapshot.title: Include Live Camera Snapshot
includeCameraSnapshot.description: OFF BY DEFAULT. Attaches a live camera.ui photo to notifications. Worth knowing before enabling: this plugin previously caused a real connection-contention incident during testing — the printer’s camera only supports one active connection at a time, and this feature competes with camera.ui’s own continuous connection for it. If you already run camera.ui with continuous recording/prebuffering/HKSV enabled, adding this on top raised real stability concerns for at least one user in practice, not just in theory. Worth watching printer health closely after enabling, especially during a print you actually care about.

cameraUiCameraName.title: camera.ui Camera Name
cameraUiCameraName.description: The exact camera name as configured in camera.ui.

githubToken.title: GitHub Personal Access Token
githubToken.description: Used to host snapshot/preview images publicly.

githubSnapshotPath.title: Snapshot File Path in Repo
githubSnapshotPath.description: This one file is overwritten each time.

includePrintPreviewImage.title: Use Sliced-File Preview Image
includePrintPreviewImage.description: Uses the slicer-rendered plate thumbnail instead of a live photo.

githubPreviewImagePath.title: Preview Image File Path in Repo
githubPreviewImagePath.description: Separate path so it doesn’t collide with the snapshot above.

discordBotToken.title: Discord Bot Token
discordBotToken.description: From the Discord Developer Portal. Connects outbound only - no public server or webhook needed.

discordUserIds.title: Discord User IDs
discordUserIds.description: One row per person to DM about spaghetti defects. Right-click a user in Discord (Developer Mode enabled) and Copy User ID.

items.title: Advanced Tuning
